label: VULCANISATION CURE
data: raw rubber failure vs Goodyear's 1844 vulcanisation cure (U.S. Patent 3,633) — 270°F (132°C) heat with sulfur and white lead after 5 years of refinement
scale: hotter than boiling water — where raw rubber turns to runny syrup, vulcanised rubber stays tough as leather
